ELECTED DEPARTMENTS

1.  Sheriff-Coroner - Adopt resolution ratifying the Chairman of the Emergency Management
  Council's Proclamation of Local Emergency for 2026 Coastal Flooding due to Hurricane Marie
  and El Nino Winter Season; and set review to determine continuing need for emergency action for
  11/17/26, 9:30 a.m. - All Districts (Click to View Files)

  ON THE MOTION OF VICE CHAIR FOLEY, SECONDED BY SUPERVISOR
  SARMIENTO, RATIFIED PROCLAMATION OF LOCAL EMERGENCY AND
  APPROVED REVISED RESOLUTION, PAGE 2, PARAGRAPH 6 TO READ
  "WHEREAS, THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS ALSO FINDS A LOCAL EMERGENCY
  DOES EXIST AND SHALL BE DEEMED TO CONTINUE TO EXIST, AND LIKELY
  IMPACTING ALL AREAS IN THE COUNTY OF ORANGE, UNTIL ITS
  TERMINATION IS PROCLAIMED BY THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS;"
  Ayes:  Nguyen, Sarmiento, Wagner, Chaffee and Foley
  Resolution No(s). 26-067
